titulo.es: Pope Leo XIV needs no further lung cancer treatment, Vatican says
titulo.en: Pope Leo XIV needs no further lung cancer treatment, Vatican says

sintesis.es: Pope Leo XIV, 71, will require no further treatment for lung cancer after tests confirmed the disease was localised, the Vatican said Wednesday. The pontiff underwent surgery last week to remove part of his right lung after being diagnosed with adenocarcinoma. He was discharged Saturday and will gradually resume activities.

titulo.es: Tesla beats earnings projections after Musk floats SpaceX merger plan
titulo.en: Tesla beats earnings projections after Musk floats SpaceX merger plan

sintesis.es: Musk says ‘there’s a lot of merit’ to potential merger that would require approval of 50% of all Tesla shareholders, but he declined to elaborate Investors were paying close attention to Tesla’s third-quarter earnings call on Wednesday afternoon, after chief executive Elon Musk floated the idea of merging the car company with his rocket and AI company, SpaceX. But they didn’t glean further information after the company announced there would be no questions on the matter. “With regard to a potential merger with SpaceX, I think I said everything that should be said yesterday,” Musk, the CEO of both companies, said on Tesla’s earnings call.

titulo.es: Caso Cambridge Analytica: Meta recibe una sanción de 25.000 millones de dólares en Nuevo México
titulo.en: Meta fined $25 billion in New Mexico over Cambridge Analytica scandal

sintesis.es: Un juez de Nuevo México ordenó a Meta pagar 25.000 millones de dólares por engañar a los usuarios sobre el uso de sus datos personales, en un caso vinculado al escándalo de Cambridge Analytica, según medios estadounidenses. La compañía calificó la sanción de "impuesto a la libertad de expresión" y anunció que apelará.
sintesis.en: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found the company deceived users in a case linked to the Cambridge Analytica scandal, media reported Wednesday. The ruling follows an $18 billion settlement with 48 other states over similar claims. Meta called the penalty “a tax on speech".

titulo.es: Informe desde San Salvador: Bukele desafía a pandillas de Haití y exige liberación de soldados
titulo.en: El Salvador launches military operation in Haiti to free four kidnapped aviation technicians

sintesis.es: El presidente salvadoreño Nayib Bukele lanzó una dura advertencia a las pandillas que mantienen retenidos a cuatro salvadoreños en Haití. Según el mandatario, los secuestrados son técnicos de aviación que participan en una misión internacional de apoyo y evacuación médica, no combatientes. Bukele anunció el inicio de una operación militar de rescate y aseguró que las acciones podrían intensificarse si los rehenes no son liberados sanos y salvos.
sintesis.en: Bukele warned that failure to free the men who have been missing since Sunday’s attack on an armoured vehicle would trigger a far more powerful operation.

titulo.es: Kenichi Yoda, Princesa de Asturias de Comunicación y Humanidades: "Ghibli está marcadamente ligado a su época"
titulo.en: Kenichi Yoda, Princess of Asturias laureate: "Ghibli is closely tied to its time"

sintesis.es: El nuevo presidente del legendario estudio japonés defiende ir en busca de la belleza incluso a la hora de delinear horrores como la guerra. Yoda, cara visible de Ghibli en Oviedo, asegura que seguirán explorando temáticas y preocupaciones contemporáneas, tal y como hicieron sus fundadores.
sintesis.en: The new president of the legendary Japanese studio argues that beauty must be sought even when portraying horrors such as war. In Oviedo, Yoda, Ghibli’s public face, says they will continue to explore contemporary themes and concerns, just as their founders did.

titulo.es: Nigeria confirms Ebola case as outbreak spreads into western Africa
titulo.en: Nigeria confirms Ebola case as outbreak spreads into western Africa

sintesis.es: Case in Africa’s most populous country was detected in a woman who had travelled from Uganda Nigeria has confirmed an Ebola case in its capital, Abuja, after a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive for the virus, the health ministry said. The woman began showing symptoms on 7 October and was admitted to a hospital in Abuja four days later, where she was later diagnosed with Ebola. It is unclear when she arrived in Nigeria, Africa’s most populous country.
